description: This Java source file defines the AppHwConfigList class, which extends ListActivity to display a list of installed applications and allows navigation to a preferences screen for each app.

classes.name: AppHwConfigList
classes.description: Main activity class that displays a list of installed applications and handles item clicks to open app-specific preferences.

classes.name: AppListAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending BaseAdapter to manage and display the list of installed applications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the adapter, and finishes if no applications are found.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity resumes.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity stops.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks to launch the AppHwPref activity for the selected application.

methods.name: appForPosition
methods.description: Returns the PackageInfo for a given list position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of applications in the list.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the list position (not the item itself).

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the list position as item ID.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a list item view and binds application data to it.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds application label to the list item view.
